verdict.rationale: Pulumi offers strong programmatic surfaces—the CLI (with scriptable JSON output, verified via local probes), an Automation API for running programs without the CLI, and an official MCP server for AI assistants to query stacks and generate/apply infra—covering core IaC lifecycle tasks headlessly. However, there's no evidence of a documented public REST/OpenAPI API for Pulumi Cloud's console-only features (policy management, insights, org/RBAC settings, Neo); probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404'd, suggesting some UI-exclusive functionality lacks full API parity.
